title: citrea-agent-kit
tagline: An Dynamic agent-kit on Citrea, Personality driven agents with inbuilt jailbreak firewall
description:
This is a dev tooling for Citrea dev ecosystem, ie an agent-kit. 

- Users can use our agent kit to create agent instances that can read and write on chain using natural language prompts 
- We are security first tool, and have an inbuilt AI firewall protection against malicious prompts and llm jailbreaks
-  ERC-20 Support: Transfer, burn, and check balances of ERC-20 tokens
- We also have support for multi AI models (eg, openAI, Antrophic)

- Users can also defne custom personalities & build fun games around it (eg, among us game between ai agents)

- Agents are also context aware & has conversational memory.

- This is a very modular and dynamic agent kit and is open sourced so if anyone wants to add their own tool they will be able to contribute frictionless.
how_its_made:
This project uses langchain for agent tooling and orchastratation, We built modular tools that agent can use to read and write on chain.

The thing we did particularly hacky is giving personalities to the agent this allows a whole new sets of applications to be build on top of the agent kit such as small games. 

The concept of the whole agent kit to make is to make it easier for developers to onboard on new chain and build some cool things without worrying about the ground work!!!
